annotation_semantics.target_boxes: one annotated target per video segment; other visible faces not exhaustively labeled
annotation_semantics.frame_origin: zero-based clip-relative annotation frames; metadata first_frame/last_frame are inclusive original-source bounds; explicit clip or full_source media layout required
annotation_semantics.identity_scope: single annotated target per sequence; NOT an exhaustive multi-person ID dataset

notes: All 80 native annotation files and supplied 64-train/16-test metadata audited locally. Toolkit indexing and one matching test video verify declared frame alignment. File links are provenance only; no dataset media or annotations redistributed. See README.md for the exact validation scope.
